author: KEXP
description: Ontario-based duo Softcult charge their melancholic sound with layers of shoegaze, dream pop, and indie rock. Live on KEXP, the siblings share a performance of "Haunt You Still" and more with host Cheryl Waters.
title: Softcult performs "Haunt You Still" & more Live on KEXP
